title: PhyDiCT
paper_title: PhyDiCT: Plug-and-Play CT Reconstruction from Sparse X-Rays via Differentiable Rendering and Strong Priors
core_mech: 在固定预训练三维扩散先验上交替施加投影观测约束与去噪更新；文本报告、几何和预训练权重都是显式条件。
core_mech_en: A frozen text-conditioned 3D diffusion prior is guided by differentiable projection consistency during inference; reports, geometry and pretrained weights are explicit conditions.
input_desc: 稀疏 X 光、采集几何、文本报告条件与预训练 MedSyn 权重
input_en: Sparse X-rays, acquisition geometry, a report condition and pretrained MedSyn weights
output_desc: 与观测相容的三维肺部 CT 候选体；仍需验证患者特异性与域外可靠性
output_en: A candidate 3D lung CT volume; patient-specific fidelity and external reliability still require validation

source.title: PhyDiCT
notes: Official MICCAI 2026 landing page and pinned author README, root LICENSE.txt, environment.yml and src/eval_low_PhyDiCT.py were inspected. The full paper PDF could not be retrieved in this check; no full-paper or numerical reproduction claim is made.
Pinned source calls CUDA directly and needs external pretrained MedSyn weights and report embeddings. No upstream environment, code or model weights were installed or executed by this update.

The root source-code license is Apache-2.0; this does not settle the separate terms of all bundled dependencies, model checkpoints or datasets. No third-party code or clinical data is redistributed here.

Conference page dates the work to MICCAI 2026; repository HEAD is dated 2026-09-25 and the arXiv record is dated 2026-10-07. The README BibTeX uses 2027; do not treat that inconsistent field as a new model release.
source.paper_read_scope: conference abstract and code availability; PDF unavailable

gaps: The official PhyDiCT inference source is available and pinned. Its pretrained MedSyn 3D diffusion prior, report embedding, calibrated projection geometry, LPIPS guidance, and CUDA-oriented sampling have not been adapted or executed locally. The synthetic database supports source study only; it is not a PhyDiCT reconstruction experiment.
